findings.title: OAuth access token exchange omits redirect_uri
findings.body: The authorization redirect includes redirect_uri (line 408), but the access token request only sends code, client_id, and client_secret. GitHub requires the same redirect_uri in the token request whenever it was supplied to /authorize. As written, GitHub will reject the exchange with bad_verification_code or redirect_uri_mismatch, causing real installations to fail. The test stub returns success without checking this parameter, so it is not caught.

findings.title: GitHub identity is verified by mutable login instead of immutable user id
findings.body: The pipeline binds only 'login' from get_user_info (lines 434-438) and later compares it to integration.metadata['sender']['login']. GitHub logins are mutable and may be released/reused after a rename, so a different account holding the old login could pass this validation. The sender payload also contains GitHub's immutable user id; compare ids (or at least bind and compare id) to ensure the OAuth-authorized user is actually the installer.

findings.title: Existing integrations without sender metadata cause KeyError
findings.body: The check directly accesses integration.metadata['sender']['login'] without guarding for missing or malformed sender data. build_integration only adds metadata['sender'] when state.get('sender') exists, and older integrations or integrations created through paths without sender will not have it. On re-install, GitHubInstallation raises KeyError and returns a 500 instead of rendering the installation error page.

findings.title: Installation-not-found test no longer reaches the 404 path
findings.body: The test uses state 'ddd023d87a913d5226e2a882c4c4cc05', while the pipeline signature in these tests is '9cae5e88803f35ed7970fc131e6e65d3'. With the new OAuthLoginView, this fails the state check before GitHubInstallation/build_integration runs, so the 404 response configured for /app/installations/{id} is never exercised. The test should use the valid pipeline state to actually cover the 'installation not found' behavior.
